persistence_if_selected.rule: In compile_flags, select /O2 instead of /O1 only when source.path is one of hot_sources; retain all other flags and all other translation units at /O1.
persistence_if_selected.proposed_code: optimization = "/O2" if source.path in HOT_SOURCES else {"MinSpace": "/O1", "MaxSpeed": "/O2", "Disabled": "/Od"}.get(source.metadata.get("Optimization"), "/O1")
